title: ServiceMaintainability
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — IT Service Maintainability viability dimension. Degree to which the IT service can be effectively and efficiently modified by the service provider. Sub-characteristics: Analysability, Modifiability, Testability. Rootless archetype — complements ProductMaintainability (ISO 25010) with service-level maintenance semantics. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.8.

analysability.description: Degree to which the IT service can be diagnosed for deficiencies, causes of failures, or parts to be modified. Norm example: ServiceMaintainability.analysability != 'LOW'.

modifiability.description: Degree to which the IT service can be effectively and efficiently changed without introducing defects or degrading existing service quality.

testability.description: Degree to which the IT service modifications can be validated through testing. Norm example: ServiceMaintainability.testability == 'HIGH'.
